source: Project model P1; supplied team allocation.

title: Define the final geometry—and how it is measured
source: Model records P1 and supplemental geometric check. Centre-line views; exterior dimensions rounded. Drawing sheets accompany the PPT.

title: How the canopy can improve pedestrian comfort
source: Shade: project P2/P5. Greening mechanisms: [1,2]. Arrows are conceptual; no temperature or airflow field is simulated.

title: Separate the support role from the crown role
source: Project take-off and proposed member schedule (P1, P3). Sections and material mass remain preliminary specifications.

title: Five criteria guide the material selection
source: Source: material-comparison workbook (P3). *Preliminary inputs; product, processing and factor boundaries need verification.

title: The crown is stiffness-sensitive: joints matter
source: Simplified beam calculation and proposed node method (P3). Wet foliage 18 kg/m² and bamboo properties are assumed inputs.

title: The unit budget includes fabrication, installation and care
source: Source: Cost-Analysis.xlsx (P3). All rates remain reference estimates rather than confirmed quotations.

title: Account for the members, base and maintenance needs
source: Workbook estimate (P3). Factor boundaries and node inclusion require checking; no biogenic-carbon credit is taken.

title: Keep the planting mix conditional on the site
source: Project planting screen P3. Botanical traits, attachment and local suitability need site/nursery confirmation.

title: Project shade onto one fixed reference zone
source: Solar geometry: NOAA [3]. Project calculations and scenario assumptions: P2, P5. Foliage/transmittance are not measured.

title: The shadow position and solar season both matter
source: Project projection data (P2, P5). Solar-season comparison under the assumed foliage geometry.

title: Seven models test three geometry controls
source: Project parameter study (P5). Controls are not uniform scaling; larger cover percentage does not imply equal plant/material input.

title: Coverage amount alone does not determine useful shade
source: Project spatial-cover calculation (P5). Frame/leaf overlap deducted, τ = 0.15; equivalent direct-beam blockage, not cooling.

title: Put occupied-hour shade into the layout decision
source: Conceptual application P4; fixed-50%-cover projection P5. No real-site compliance or measured comfort result is claimed; method lead [4].

title: Coordinate prefabricated modules and site interfaces
source: Project member/assembly and cost schedule (P3, P4). Proposed detail and labour quantities, not a tested construction programme.

title: Connect geometry, construction and useful shade
source: Synthesis of project records P1–P5. Product, joint and site-specific evidence are the next verification priorities.

source: Literature entries were supplied with project records; original-source checks remain pending. Unverified factors are not presented as certified standards.
